content:
alice: starting canary v4.6.2 to us-west in 02:00 UTC window. 5% at 02:05. Watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx, and synthetic ping. tag: v4-6-2-canary

ben: ack. traffic rule created, fallback pinned to v4-5-9. smoke script ready.

devops-bot: canary_start by @alice at 02:05 UTC. canary_id=canary-5290001111. routing: 5% -> v4-6-2-canary. monitors armed.

slo-bot: ALERT: p99-latency-us-west jumped to 980ms at 02:08 UTC (baseline 260ms). p95 stable. tagging thread.

alice: interesting — p95 is fine but p99 tail. Ben, can you check traces for tail ops or retry storms? Hold ramp.

ben: digging. traces show a small subset of requests hitting a new transformer layer fallback that adds decode retries under certain prompt lengths. patching runtime flag to disable fallback for canary.

devops-bot: runtime_flag change applied to canary pool: transformer.fallback=false. Reprobes running.

slo-bot: p99 down to 240ms at 02:13 UTC. synthetic ping stable.

alice: proceeding to 25% at 02:20. keep fallback disabled for 30m. If p99 spikes again or 5xx >0.3% we rollback. React with :rotating_light: to call immediate rollback.

ben: noted and will monitor.

revert-bot: scheduled rollback job is on standby. Command to run immediate rollback: POST /v1/deployments/rollback {"canary_id":"canary-5290001111","rollback_to":"v4-5-9"}

alice: thanks all. summary in 30m unless anything else pops.
